svg.title: Ferry · 客户端 / 上游
svg.desc: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and DeepSeek Harness connect through Ferry to API providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, Kimi and GLM, or supported ChatGPT and Claude Code subscription accounts. Illustrative configuration options, not a client certification matrix. Actual compatibility depends on protocol, route, model capabilities and account permissions.
